notes.title: Demo Update #1.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! A couple of small updates to the demo. Working hard on the actual game at the moment that I can hopefully submit in time for Steam to approve with still an expected release date end of 2025/beginning of 2026. 

Patchnotes of the demo:

Made the menu ball more accurate to give a better feel

Made the ball in the wooden level more accurate to the Steam Deck movement. Maybe the record can be beaten now?! I tried myself, but failed. 

Removed the rolling sound. Looking at different options to add it back, but have people decide if they can mute it. 



Thank you all for trying out the demo and let me know in the discussions if you have any feedback/bugs on the demo!

notes.title: Sound effects, demo update/fixes and more
notes.notes:
A new mini devlog about Game With Balls with an update on one of the most requested features: SFX for the ball when it is on wood. I experimented a while with this and still tweaking, recording and adjusting it to make it feel right for every level, but it is here! And you can test it in the Demo where it is now added to the main menu and level 3.   



Let me know what you think! More updates in the mini devlog video. 

 
[previewyoutube="9ehJoxrVzZg;full"][/previewyoutube]


Also did a couple of bugfixes in the demo that were reported by you guys! Thank you for that and let me know if there are any more bugs you can spot. 

Demo v1.1.1 Bugfixes 

Demo level 3 music is now reacting to the volume slider in the main menu

Loading screens had rare occasion of not showing if it was needed, but that is now fixed


Other news

This week Better With A Friend is 40% off because last week it was its one year anniversary. But.. I forgot to set the discount for that week. Thank you everyone for the support and lovely messages I got from people that played it with their loved ones.
